_doc: Kid-safe content gate for K-3 phonics worksheets. Whole-word, case-insensitive match against every student-facing token (sentences, instructions, word lists, picture words). A 'blocked' hit FAILS the build. 'allow' lists reviewed exceptions that would otherwise read as edgy but are age-appropriate in context. Decodability only proves phonetic legality — a word can decode cleanly and still be a bad pick (skull, knife). Extend the lists as new picks are reviewed.

allow.hurt: safe in context (e.g. a scraped knee), reviewed OK
